service_rules.cancellation_rebooking_rule: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, the customer is entitled to a free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours, or a full refund, customer's choice.

delay_compensation_rule.more_than_5_hours: meal voucher + hotel accommodation, covering only the delayed hours (not a full night's stay)

service_rules.refund_processing_rule: Refunds for airline-caused cancellations are processed in full within 7 business days. Refunds are issued to the original payment method only.
service_rules.fare_difference_rule: If a customer voluntarily chooses to rebook on a higher-fare flight (not airline-caused), they must pay the fare difference. Agents cannot waive fare differences above Rs. 1500 without supervisor approval.
service_rules.loyalty_tier_rule: Gold and Platinum tier customers get priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats) but no additional compensation beyond the standard policy.

allowed_actions: Rebook the customer on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge (airline-caused disruption)
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per the delay compensation rule, where the delay qualifies
Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours compensation rule, where the delay qualifies
Initiate a refund request for airline-caused cancellations
Provide the customer's own booking and flight status information
prohibited_actions: Approving any compensation beyond the stated policy amounts
Waiving a fare difference above Rs. 1500
Making exceptions for non-airline-caused disruptions (e.g., customer missed the flight)
Handling threats of legal action or formal complaints - must be escalated immediately
Processing refunds to a different payment method than the original

SR-01.name: Cancellation Rebooking
SR-01.text: Airline-cancelled flight: free rebooking on next available flight within 24 hours, OR full refund - customer's choice.

SR-03.name: Delay Compensation (3 to 5 hours)
SR-03.text: Delay more than 3 hours: meal voucher + lounge access.

SR-04.name: Delay Compensation (over 5 hours)
SR-04.text: Delay more than 5 hours: meal voucher + hotel accommodation covering only the delayed hours, not a full night's stay.

SR-05.name: Refund Processing
SR-05.text: Airline-caused cancellation refunds: full amount within 7 business days, to the original payment method only.

SR-06.name: Fare Difference Limit
SR-06.text: Voluntary rebooking on a higher-fare flight: customer pays the fare difference. Agent cannot waive above Rs. 1500 without supervisor approval.

SR-07.name: Loyalty Tier Priority
SR-07.text: Gold and Platinum get priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats), but no extra compensation beyond standard policy.

AA-01.name: ALLOWED: Free rebooking within 24h
AA-01.text: Rebook the customer on the next available flight within 24 hours at no charge (airline-caused disruption).

AA-02.name: ALLOWED: Meal voucher / lounge access
AA-02.text: Issue meal vouchers and lounge access per the delay compensation rule, where the delay qualifies.

AA-03.name: ALLOWED: Hotel accommodation
AA-03.text: Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours compensation rule, where the delay qualifies.

AA-04.name: ALLOWED: Initiate refund
AA-04.text: Initiate a refund request for airline-caused cancellations.

AA-05.name: ALLOWED: Provide booking / flight status
AA-05.text: Provide the customer's own booking and flight status information.

P-01.name: PROHIBITED: Compensation beyond policy
P-01.text: Approving any compensation beyond the stated policy amounts. Must be escalated.

P-02.name: PROHIBITED: Fare difference waiver above Rs. 1500
P-02.text: Waiving a fare difference above Rs. 1500. Must be escalated to a supervisor.

P-03.name: PROHIBITED: Exceptions for non-airline-caused disruptions
P-03.text: Making exceptions for non-airline-caused disruptions (e.g. customer missed the flight). Must be escalated.

P-04.name: PROHIBITED: Legal action / formal complaint
P-04.text: Threats of legal action or formal complaints must be escalated immediately.

P-05.name: PROHIBITED: Refund to a different payment method
P-05.text: Processing refunds to a payment method other than the original. Must be escalated.

SYS-01.name: System: PNR not found
SYS-01.text: No customer record matched the booking reference provided.

SYS-02.name: System: Empty message
SYS-02.text: No message content received from the customer.

SYS-03.name: System: Conversation already escalated
SYS-03.text: Conversation is already with a human specialist. No further automated action is taken.

SYS-04.name: System: No confident intent match
SYS-04.text: The message did not match any known intent with confidence. Agent asked a clarifying question instead of guessing.

GRD-01.name: Output Guardrail - Reply Scan
GRD-01.text: Second-line safety check: before any reply reaches the customer, its actual text is scanned - independent of which intent path produced it - for language that would promise free/waived compensation, an unescalated amount above Rs. 1500, or a refund to a different payment method. This exists so a future bug in intent detection can't silently let a prohibited promise reach the customer.
